import bpy, math, os
from mathutils import Vector

# Clear scene
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for coll in (bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.curves, bpy.data.cameras, bpy.data.lights):
    pass

scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'

# Materials
def mat(name, color, roughness=0.3, metallic=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    # clearcoat if present
    for key in ('Coat Weight','Clearcoat'):
        if key in bsdf.inputs:
            bsdf.inputs[key].default_value = 0.35
            break
    return m

YELLOW = mat('Yellow Plastic', (1.0, 0.83, 0.07), 0.18)
YELLOW2 = mat('Yellow Slightly Dark', (0.95, 0.77, 0.05), 0.22)
BLACK = mat('Black Plastic', (0.015,0.015,0.018), 0.28)
BLACK_SOFT = mat('Black Matte', (0.03,0.03,0.03), 0.45)
WHITE = mat('White', (0.97,0.97,0.95), 0.25)
EYE_WHITE = mat('Eye White', (0.92,0.92,0.90), 0.12)
PUPIL = mat('Pupil Black', (0.005,0.005,0.005), 0.15)
RIM = mat('Eye Rim', (0.08,0.05,0.03), 0.25, 0.35)
GROOVE = mat('Groove Gold', (0.72,0.56,0.02), 0.35)
GREY_TXT = mat('Top Print', (0.85,0.85,0.85), 0.4)

robie = []  # objects to export
def reg(obj, material=None, name=None):
    if name: obj.name = name
    if material and hasattr(obj.data, 'materials'):
        obj.data.materials.append(material)
    robie.append(obj)
    return obj

def smooth(obj):
    if obj.type=='MESH':
        for p in obj.data.polygons:
            p.use_smooth = True
    return obj

def bevel(obj, width=0.02, segments=3):
    if obj.type!='MESH': return obj
    m = obj.modifiers.new('Bevel','BEVEL')
    m.width = width; m.segments = segments
    m.limit_method='ANGLE'
    return obj

# ---- Lathe helper (profile r,z around Z) ----
def lathe(name, profile, material, segments=64):
    # profile list bottom->top, include r=0 caps if desired
    verts=[]; faces=[]
    rings=[]
    for (r,z) in profile:
        ring=[]
        if r < 1e-6:
            idx=len(verts); verts.append((0,0,z)); ring=[idx]*segments
        else:
            for i in range(segments):
                a=2*math.pi*i/segments
                ring.append(len(verts)); verts.append((r*math.cos(a), r*math.sin(a), z))
        rings.append(ring)
    for j in range(len(profile)-1):
        for i in range(segments):
            i2=(i+1)%segments
            a,b,c,d = rings[j][i], rings[j][i2], rings[j+1][i2], rings[j+1][i]
            if a==b or c==d:
                faces.append((a,c,d)) if a!=c else None
                if a==b and c!=d:
                    faces[-1]=(a,b,c) if False else (a,c,d)
                # degenerate handling simple triangles
            else:
                faces.append((a,b,c,d))
    # fix degenerate duplicate faces: keep unique valid
    faces=[f for f in faces if len(set(f))>=3]
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+'Mesh')
    mesh.from_pydata(verts, [], faces); mesh.update()
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    mesh.materials.append(material)
    smooth(obj)
    robie.append(obj)
    return obj

# ---- Body and Head ----
# Lower body: bell-ish cylinder, bottom ~0.30 top 1.04
lathe('Body', [
    (0.0,0.30),(0.38,0.30),(0.55,0.315),(0.625,0.36),(0.655,0.46),(0.65,0.62),
    (0.63,0.80),(0.605,0.95),(0.575,1.03),(0.52,1.05),(0.0,1.05)
], YELLOW)

# Head: upper cylinder 1.07 to 1.60
lathe('Head', [
    (0.0,1.07),(0.50,1.07),(0.585,1.09),(0.62,1.16),(0.635,1.28),(0.635,1.44),
    (0.62,1.54),(0.57,1.595),(0.48,1.61),(0.0,1.61)
], YELLOW)

# Neck gap black ring
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64, radius=0.60, depth=0.045, location=(0,0,1.055))
reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object), BLACK, 'NeckGap')
# Bottom base black
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64, radius=0.58, depth=0.09, location=(0,0,0.285))
reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object), BLACK, 'BasePlate')
# chassis connector between feet (black block behind base visible at back)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0,0.18,0.22))
o=bpy.context.active_object; o.dimensions=(1.05,0.70,0.10); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
bevel(o,0.04); reg(o, BLACK, 'Chassis')

# Top black disc
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64, radius=0.515, depth=0.028, location=(0,0,1.613))
reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object), BLACK, 'TopDisc')
# Top groove lines (thin grey-dark stripes toward back half)
for i in range(6):
    y = 0.08 + i*0.035
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0,y,1.629))
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.dimensions=(0.88,0.008,0.004); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    reg(o, BLACK_SOFT, f'TopGroove{i}')
    o.scale.x = 1 # lines across

# Text helper
def add_text(name, body, size, location, rotation, material, align='CENTER', extrude=0.004, bevel_t=0.001):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'FONT'); cu.body=body; cu.size=size; cu.align_x=align; cu.align_y='CENTER'
    cu.extrude=extrude; cu.bevel_depth=bevel_t
    try: cu.font = bpy.data.fonts.load('/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf')
    except: pass
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cu); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location=location; obj.rotation_euler=rotation
    cu.materials.append(material); robie.append(obj)
    return obj

# Top print: readable from front (so appears upside-down from back, as in ref)
add_text('TopLogo','Radio Shack',0.11,(0,-0.06,1.628),(0,0,math.radians(180)),GREY_TXT,extrude=0.002)
add_text('TopSub','ROBOTIC BANKER',0.045,(0,-0.17,1.628),(0,0,math.radians(180)),GREY_TXT,extrude=0.002)
# small $ badge on top
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.055, minor_radius=0.008, major_segments=32, minor_segments=8, location=(-0.28,-0.05,1.628))
reg(bpy.context.active_object, GREY_TXT,'TopBadgeRing')
add_text('TopBadge','$',0.08,(-0.28,-0.05,1.630),(0,0,math.radians(180)),GREY_TXT,extrude=0.002)

# ---- Eyes ----
for side, sx in [('L',-0.215),('R',0.215)]:
    # rim torus facing front (-Y): torus default in XY plane facing Z; rotate X 90 -> facing Y
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.125, minor_radius=0.022, major_segments=40, minor_segments=12,
        location=(sx,-0.565,1.375), rotation=(math.radians(90),0,0))
    reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object), RIM, f'EyeRim{side}')
    # dark socket disc behind
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=32, radius=0.128, depth=0.03, location=(sx,-0.545,1.375), rotation=(math.radians(90),0,0))
    reg(bpy.context.active_object, BLACK_SOFT, f'EyeSocket{side}')
    # eyeball white sphere recessed, protruding slightly
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=32, ring_count=24, radius=0.115, location=(sx,-0.555,1.375))
    reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object), EYE_WHITE, f'Eyeball{side}')
    # pupil at bottom-front (googly, looking down)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=24, ring_count=16, radius=0.068, location=(sx,-0.635,1.315))
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.scale=(1.0,0.55,0.75); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    reg(smooth(o), PUPIL, f'Pupil{side}')

# Little teeth/pegs in neck gap at front
for i, tx in enumerate((-0.055,0.055)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=12, radius=0.018, depth=0.07, location=(tx,-0.53,1.04))
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.rotation_euler=(math.radians(12),0,0)
    reg(smooth(o), WHITE, f'Tooth{i}')

# ---- ROBIE logo front ----
# Text facing -Y: rotate X -90? Text plane XY facing +Z. Rotate X=+90 maps +Z to -Y.
add_text('ROBIE_Logo','ROBIE',0.135,(-0.23,-0.622,0.905),(math.radians(90),0,math.radians(180)),BLACK,align='LEFT',extrude=0.005)
# Vertical centre seam front + back (thin dark line)
for nm, y in [('SeamFront',-0.643),('SeamBack',0.630)]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0,y,0.68))
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.dimensions=(0.006,0.008,0.65); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    reg(o, GROOVE, nm)

# Coin slot on back of head lower band
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0,0.618,1.13))
o=bpy.context.active_object; o.dimensions=(0.13,0.015,0.022); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
reg(o, BLACK, 'CoinSlot')

# ---- Shoulders ----
for side, sx in [('L',-1),('R',1)]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=40, radius=0.185, depth=0.20,
        location=(sx*0.655,0,0.845), rotation=(0,math.radians(90),0))
    o=smooth(bpy.context.active_object); bevel(o,0.025); reg(o, YELLOW, f'Shoulder{side}')
    # inner hub ring groove
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.185, minor_radius=0.008, major_segments=36, minor_segments=8,
        location=(sx*0.585,0,0.845), rotation=(0,math.radians(90),0))
    reg(bpy.context.active_object, GROOVE, f'ShoulderGroove{side}')

# ---- Arms as beveled curves ----
def tube(name, points, radius=0.042, material=BLACK):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE'); cu.dimensions='3D'; cu.bevel_depth=radius; cu.bevel_resolution=5
    cu.resolution_u=12
    sp=cu.splines.new('BEZIER'); sp.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for bp,p in zip(sp.bezier_points, points):
        bp.co=p; bp.handle_left_type='AUTO'; bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cu); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    cu.materials.append(material); robie.append(obj)
    return obj

# Tray arm (+X): down, forward, in to support tray
tube('ArmTray', [(0.66,-0.02,0.82),(0.80,-0.08,0.66),(0.80,-0.30,0.50),(0.66,-0.55,0.50),(0.48,-0.68,0.565)])
# Claw arm (-X): down and forward
tube('ArmClaw', [(-0.66,-0.02,0.82),(-0.80,-0.08,0.62),(-0.80,-0.28,0.44),(-0.76,-0.42,0.38)])

# Claw: C hook in XZ plane at end of left arm
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.135, minor_radius=0.042, major_segments=36, minor_segments=12,
    location=(-0.72,-0.44,0.245), rotation=(math.radians(90),0,math.radians(-15)))
o=bpy.context.active_object
# Torus arc: use full torus then hide gap by rotating? Instead set arc via operator redo not available; keep 270 via geometry later simple: apply boolean cut
reg(smooth(o), BLACK, 'ClawHook')
# Cut opening in claw with a cutter cube (boolean)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(-0.59,-0.44,0.335))
cutter=bpy.context.active_object; cutter.dimensions=(0.22,0.20,0.22); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=o
mod=o.modifiers.new('ClawCut','BOOLEAN'); mod.operation='DIFFERENCE'; mod.object=cutter
bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier='ClawCut')
bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter, do_unlink=True)

# ---- Coin tray (+X front) ----
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=48, radius=0.255, depth=0.035, location=(0.26,-0.80,0.58))
o=bpy.context.active_object; o.scale=(1.28,0.88,1.0); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
bevel(o,0.012); reg(smooth(o), BLACK, 'CoinTray')
# small spout tip at +X edge of tray
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=24, radius1=0.075, radius2=0.01, depth=0.16,
    location=(0.62,-0.80,0.58), rotation=(0,math.radians(-90),0))
o=bpy.context.active_object; o.scale=(1,1,0.28)
# note scale after rotation tricky; flatten z global via dimensions
bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
reg(smooth(o), BLACK, 'TraySpout')
# raised rim? thin torus scaled oval on edge
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.24, minor_radius=0.012, major_segments=48, minor_segments=8, location=(0.26,-0.80,0.596))
o=bpy.context.active_object; o.scale=(1.28,0.88,1); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
reg(smooth(o), BLACK, 'TrayRim')
# White $ decal ring + symbol on top
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.155, minor_radius=0.009, major_segments=48, minor_segments=8, location=(0.26,-0.80,0.600))
reg(bpy.context.active_object, WHITE, 'TrayRing')
add_text('TrayDollar','$',0.24,(0.26,-0.80,0.600),(0,0,math.radians(90)),WHITE,extrude=0.003)

# ---- Feet ----
def make_foot(side, sx):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=40, ring_count=28, radius=1.0, location=(sx*0.52,-0.40,0.125))
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.scale=(0.205,0.48,0.145); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    # taper toe (-Y end) and flatten bottom, raise heel
    mesh=o.data
    cx,cy,cz = o.location
    for v in mesh.vertices:
        ny = (v.co.y)/0.48  # -1 toe ... +1 heel (object local after apply? verts are local scaled)
        # local coords are around origin with extents as scaled
        if v.co.y < 0:
            t = abs(v.co.y)/0.48
            f = 1.0 - 0.62*(t**2.2)
            v.co.x *= max(f,0.18)
            v.co.z *= max(1.0-0.35*(t**2),0.35)
        if v.co.z < -0.085:
            v.co.z = -0.085
    mesh.update()
    o.rotation_euler=(0,0,math.radians(-sx*7))
    reg(smooth(o), YELLOW, f'Foot{side}')
    # sole: flattened copy
    sole=o.copy(); sole.data=o.data.copy(); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(sole)
    sole.name=f'Sole{side}'; sole.scale=(1.04,1.02,0.38); sole.location=(sx*0.52,-0.40,0.045)
    sole.data.materials.clear(); sole.data.materials.append(BLACK)
    robie.append(sole)
    # grooves across foot near heel: two thin tori in XZ plane
    for i, dy in enumerate((0.18,0.235)):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.175, minor_radius=0.006, major_segments=32, minor_segments=6,
            location=(sx*0.52 + math.sin(math.radians(-sx*7))*(-dy)*0 , -0.40+dy, 0.135),
            rotation=(math.radians(90),0,math.radians(-sx*7)))
        g=bpy.context.active_object; g.scale=(1,0.72,1)  # squash vertical-ish
        reg(g, GROOVE, f'FootGroove{side}{i}')
    return o
make_foot('L',-1); make_foot('R',1)

# ---- Scene: world, ground, lights, camera ----
world=bpy.data.worlds['World']; world.use_nodes=True
bg=world.node_tree.nodes['Background']; bg.inputs[0].default_value=(0.92,0.92,0.92,1); bg.inputs[1].default_value=0.75

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=14, location=(0,0,0))
ground=bpy.context.active_object; ground.name='Ground'
gm=mat('GroundMat',(0.90,0.90,0.90),0.9); ground.data.materials.append(gm)

def area(name, loc, energy, size=3):
    ld=bpy.data.lights.new(name,'AREA'); ld.energy=energy; ld.shape='DISK'; ld.size=size
    lo=bpy.data.objects.new(name,ld); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(lo); lo.location=loc
    # point at robot centre
    direction=Vector((0,0,0.8))-Vector(loc); lo.rotation_euler=direction.to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
    return lo
area('Key',(2.5,-3.0,3.5),900,3)
area('Fill',(-3.0,-1.5,2.0),350,3)
area('Top',(0,1.5,4.0),400,3)

camd=bpy.data.cameras.new('Camera'); camd.lens=42
cam=bpy.data.objects.new('Camera',camd); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(cam)
scene.camera=cam

def set_cam(loc, target=(0,-0.05,0.85)):
    cam.location=loc
    d=Vector(target)-Vector(loc); cam.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()

scene.render.engine='CYCLES'
scene.cycles.samples=64
scene.cycles.use_denoising=True
scene.render.resolution_x=900; scene.render.resolution_y=900
scene.render.film_transparent=False
scene.view_settings.view_transform='Standard'

os.makedirs('renders',exist_ok=True)
views={
 'front': (0.0,-3.6,1.15),
 'front34': (2.4,-3.0,1.7),
 'side': (3.6,-0.4,1.2),
 'back34': (-2.2,3.0,1.9),
 'top': (0.6,-1.8,3.8),
}
for name,loc in views.items():
    set_cam(loc)
    scene.render.filepath=f'renders/preview_{name}.png'
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)

bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath='robie.blend')
result={'objects':[o.name for o in robie], 'count':len(robie)}

import bpy, math, os
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
scene = bpy.context.scene

def mat(name, color, roughness=0.3, metallic=0.0, coat=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    if coat:
        for k in ('Coat Weight','Clearcoat'):
            if k in b.inputs: b.inputs[k].default_value = coat; break
    return m

YELLOW = mat('Yellow Plastic', (1.0,0.78,0.02), 0.24, coat=0.25)
BLACK  = mat('Black Plastic', (0.012,0.012,0.014), 0.32, coat=0.15)
BLACKM = mat('Black Matte', (0.02,0.02,0.02), 0.65)
WHITE  = mat('White', (0.96,0.96,0.94), 0.25)
EYEW   = mat('Eye White', (0.90,0.90,0.88), 0.15)
PUPIL  = mat('Pupil', (0.004,0.004,0.004), 0.18)
GROOVE = mat('Groove Shadow', (0.45,0.32,0.0), 0.6)
DARKLN = mat('Dark Line', (0.05,0.05,0.05), 0.8)
PRINT  = mat('Top Print', (0.82,0.82,0.82), 0.5)

robie=[]
def reg(obj, material=None, name=None):
    if name: obj.name=name
    if material and hasattr(obj.data,'materials'): obj.data.materials.append(material)
    robie.append(obj); return obj
def smooth(obj):
    if obj.type=='MESH':
        for p in obj.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return obj
def bevel(obj,w=0.02,s=3):
    if obj.type=='MESH':
        m=obj.modifiers.new('Bevel','BEVEL'); m.width=w; m.segments=s; m.limit_method='ANGLE'
    return obj
def apply_scale(obj):
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=obj
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT'); obj.select_set(True)
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)

def lathe(name, profile, material, segments=64):
    verts=[]; faces=[]; rings=[]
    for r,z in profile:
        if r<1e-6:
            idx=len(verts); verts.append((0,0,z)); rings.append([idx]*segments)
        else:
            ring=[]
            for i in range(segments):
                a=2*math.pi*i/segments; ring.append(len(verts)); verts.append((r*math.cos(a),r*math.sin(a),z))
            rings.append(ring)
    for j in range(len(profile)-1):
        for i in range(segments):
            i2=(i+1)%segments
            a,b,c,d=rings[j][i],rings[j][i2],rings[j+1][i2],rings[j+1][i]
            f=(a,b,c,d)
            if len(set(f))>=3: faces.append(f)
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+'Mesh'); mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); mesh.update()
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    mesh.materials.append(material); smooth(obj); robie.append(obj); return obj

def add_text(name, body, size, location, rotation, material, align='CENTER', extrude=0.004, font='Arial Bold.ttf'):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'FONT'); cu.body=body; cu.size=size; cu.align_x=align; cu.align_y='CENTER'
    cu.extrude=extrude; cu.bevel_depth=0.0008
    try: cu.font=bpy.data.fonts.load('/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/'+font)
    except Exception as e: print('font',e)
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cu); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location=location; obj.rotation_euler=rotation; cu.materials.append(material); robie.append(obj); return obj

# Body / Head
lathe('Body',[(0,0.30),(0.38,0.30),(0.55,0.315),(0.625,0.36),(0.655,0.46),(0.65,0.62),(0.63,0.80),(0.605,0.95),(0.575,1.03),(0.52,1.05),(0,1.05)],YELLOW)
lathe('Head',[(0,1.07),(0.50,1.07),(0.585,1.09),(0.62,1.16),(0.635,1.28),(0.635,1.44),(0.62,1.54),(0.57,1.595),(0.48,1.61),(0,1.61)],YELLOW)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64,radius=0.575,depth=0.045,location=(0,0,1.055))
reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object),BLACKM,'NeckGap')
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64,radius=0.57,depth=0.09,location=(0,0,0.285))
reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object),BLACK,'BasePlate')
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64,radius=0.515,depth=0.028,location=(0,0,1.613))
reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object),BLACK,'TopDisc')

# Top grooves near back edge
for i in range(5):
    y=0.20+i*0.042
    length=2*math.sqrt(max(0.515**2-y*y,0.01))-0.08
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=(0,y,1.628))
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.dimensions=(length,0.010,0.004); reg(o,DARKLN,f'TopGroove{i}')

add_text('TopLogo','Radio Shack',0.105,(-0.04,-0.05,1.628),(0,0,0),PRINT,extrude=0.002)
add_text('TopSub','ROBOTIC BANKER',0.042,(-0.04,-0.155,1.628),(0,0,0),PRINT,extrude=0.002)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.052,minor_radius=0.007,major_segments=32,minor_segments=8,location=(0.30,-0.05,1.628))
reg(bpy.context.active_object,PRINT,'TopBadgeRing')
add_text('TopBadge','$',0.075,(0.30,-0.05,1.629),(0,0,0),PRINT,extrude=0.002)

# Eyes: rim on head surface, eyeball recessed, pupil low
for side,sx in [('L',-0.215),('R',0.215)]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.122,minor_radius=0.020,major_segments=40,minor_segments=12,location=(sx,-0.600,1.375),rotation=(math.radians(90),0,0))
    reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object),BLACK,f'EyeRim{side}')
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=32,ring_count=24,radius=0.112,location=(sx,-0.575,1.375))
    reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object),EYEW,f'Eyeball{side}')
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=24,ring_count=16,radius=0.066,location=(sx,-0.652,1.312))
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.scale=(1.0,0.55,0.72); reg(smooth(o),PUPIL,f'Pupil{side}')

for i,tx in enumerate((-0.05,0.05)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=12,radius1=0.020,radius2=0.010,depth=0.06,location=(tx,-0.535,1.045),rotation=(math.radians(180),0,0))
    reg(smooth(bpy.context.active_object),WHITE,f'Tooth{i}')

# ROBIE logo (front, left of seam) - rotation X+90 faces -Y, readable from front
add_text('ROBIE_Logo','ROBIE',0.115,(-0.235,-0.620,0.905),(math.radians(90),0,0),BLACK,extrude=0.005,font='Arial Black.ttf')

for nm,y in [('SeamFront',-0.642),('SeamBack',0.628)]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=(0,y,0.68))
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.dimensions=(0.005,0.008,0.64); reg(o,GROOVE,nm)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=(0,0.616,1.13))
o=bpy.context.active_object; o.dimensions=(0.13,0.015,0.020); reg(o,BLACKM,'CoinSlot')

# Shoulders
for side,sx in [('L',-1),('R',1)]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=40,radius=0.205,depth=0.22,location=(sx*0.66,0,0.845),rotation=(0,math.radians(90),0))
    o=smooth(bpy.context.active_object); bevel(o,0.02); reg(o,YELLOW,f'Shoulder{side}')
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.205,minor_radius=0.006,major_segments=36,minor_segments=8,location=(sx*0.575,0,0.845),rotation=(0,math.radians(90),0))
    reg(bpy.context.active_object,GROOVE,f'ShoulderGroove{side}')

# Arms
def tube(name,points,radius=0.042):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE'); cu.dimensions='3D'; cu.bevel_depth=radius; cu.bevel_resolution=5; cu.resolution_u=10
    sp=cu.splines.new('BEZIER'); sp.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for bp,p in zip(sp.bezier_points,points):
        bp.co=p; bp.handle_left_type='AUTO'; bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cu); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj); cu.materials.append(BLACK); robie.append(obj); return obj

tube('ArmTray',[(0.68,-0.02,0.80),(0.76,-0.12,0.62),(0.70,-0.40,0.51),(0.50,-0.62,0.56)])
tube('ArmClaw',[(-0.68,-0.02,0.80),(-0.78,-0.12,0.58),(-0.76,-0.32,0.40),(-0.73,-0.42,0.36)])

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.14,minor_radius=0.042,major_segments=36,minor_segments=12,location=(-0.71,-0.44,0.235),rotation=(math.radians(90),0,math.radians(-10)))

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=(-0.565,-0.44,0.33))
cutter=bpy.context.active_object; cutter.dimensions=(0.22,0.22,0.24)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=claw
mod=claw.modifiers.new('ClawCut','BOOLEAN'); mod.operation='DIFFERENCE'; mod.object=cutter
bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier='ClawCut'); bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter,do_unlink=True)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=24,radius1=0.060,radius2=0.005,depth=0.15,location=(0.625,-0.80,0.58),rotation=(0,math.radians(-90),0))
o=bpy.context.active_object; o.scale=(1,0.30,1)

reg(smooth(o),BLACK,'TraySpout')
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.155,minor_radius=0.009,major_segments=48,minor_segments=8,location=(0.26,-0.80,0.599))
reg(bpy.context.active_object,WHITE,'TrayRing')

            t=abs(v.co.y)
            v.co.x*=max(1.0-0.55*t*t,0.30)
            v.co.z*=max(1.0-0.30*t*t,0.45)
        if v.co.z<-0.60: v.co.z=-0.60
    o.data.update()
    o.scale=(0.205,0.48,0.145); o.rotation_euler=(0,0,math.radians(-sx*6))
    reg(smooth(o),YELLOW,f'Foot{side}')
    sole=o.copy(); sole.data=o.data.copy(); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(sole)
    sole.name=f'Sole{side}'; sole.scale=(0.215,0.49,0.055); sole.location=(sx*0.52,-0.42,0.038)
    sole.data.materials.clear(); sole.data.materials.append(BLACK); robie.append(sole)
    for i,dy in enumerate((0.20,0.26)):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=0.168,minor_radius=0.005,major_segments=32,minor_segments=6,

        g=bpy.context.active_object; g.scale=(1,0.72,1); reg(g,GROOVE,f'FootGroove{side}{i}')

bg=world.node_tree.nodes['Background']; bg.inputs[0].default_value=(0.88,0.88,0.88,1); bg.inputs[1].default_value=0.55

ground=bpy.context.active_object; ground.name='Ground'; ground.data.materials.append(mat('GroundMat',(0.86,0.86,0.86),0.9))

    lo=bpy.data.objects.new(name,ld); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(lo); lo.location=loc

bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath='robie.blend')

import bpy, os
from mathutils import Vector

scene = bpy.context.scene
os.makedirs('output', exist_ok=True)

# Seamless studio: ground as shadow catcher only
ground = bpy.data.objects.get('Ground')
if ground:
    try:
        ground.cycles.is_shadow_catcher = True
    except Exception as e:
        print('shadow catcher', e)
world = bpy.data.worlds['World']
bg = world.node_tree.nodes['Background']
bg.inputs[0].default_value = (0.93, 0.93, 0.93, 1)
bg.inputs[1].default_value = 0.5

cam = bpy.data.objects['Camera']
def set_cam(loc, target=(0, -0.08, 0.82)):
    cam.location = loc
    cam.rotation_euler = (Vector(target) - Vector(loc)).to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()

scene.cycles.samples = 96
scene.render.resolution_x = 1200
scene.render.resolution_y = 1200

views = {
    'robie_hero.png': ((2.35, -3.05, 1.85), (0, -0.08, 0.82)),
    'robie_front.png': ((0.0, -3.9, 1.30), (0, -0.08, 0.82)),
    'robie_back_top.png': ((-1.7, 2.4, 3.1), (0, 0.0, 0.95)),
}
for fname, (loc, tgt) in views.items():
    set_cam(loc, tgt)
    scene.render.filepath = 'output/' + fname
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)

# Convert text / curve objects to meshes for a clean GLB
exclude = {'Ground', 'Camera', 'Key', 'Fill', 'Top'}
robie_objs = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.name not in exclude and o.type in ('MESH', 'CURVE', 'FONT')]
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in robie_objs:
    o.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = robie_objs[0]
bpy.ops.object.convert(target='MESH')
# Re-select after conversion
robie_objs = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.name not in exclude and o.type == 'MESH']
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in robie_objs:
    o.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = robie_objs[0]

bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(
    filepath=os.path.abspath('output/robie_the_banker.glb'),
    export_format='GLB',
    use_selection=True,
    export_apply=True,
    export_draco_mesh_compression_enable=False,
)
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath='robie.blend')
result = {'exported': [o.name for o in robie_objs], 'glb_size': os.path.getsize('output/robie_the_banker.glb')}
